summary: Verstappen hunts a third consecutive victory as McLaren closes the championship gap with improved pace through the high-speed Madring layout. Ferrari and Mercedes battle for third-best performance credentials while teams exploit the circuit's fresh surface characteristics for aerodynamic breakthroughs. A podium finish for Norris or Leclerc could narrow Verstappen's championship lead to single digits and reshape the title fight's momentum heading into the autumn flyaway races.
